SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q10. The curved surface area of a cylinder of height 14 cm is 88 cm². The diameter of the base is:
(a) 1 cm
(b) 2 cm
(c) 3 cm
(d) 4 cm

Answer / Solution:
CSA = 2πrh
88 = 2 × (22/7) × r × 14
88 = 88r => r = 1 cm
Diameter = 2r = 2 cm
Answer: (b) 2 cm
